title: Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii
synopsis:
Somei Renji is Somei Yoshino’s grandfather and leader of the “Somei Group”, the Kansai region’s biggest yakuza group. When he arranges for her to be married to Miyama Kirishima, Yoshino has to move to “Miyama Clan” estate, the Kanto region’s biggest yakuza group. Kirishima warmly welcomes Yoshino and is such a pleasant, personable, and nice young man that nobody would suspect that he comes from a yakuza family. This puts Yoshino at ease even though she was initially feeling insecure in this unfamiliar place.

But then, a certain event leads to Yoshino witnessing the real Kirishima.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Ain't no place for losers here
episodes.synopsis:
Yoshino, the granddaughter of the local yakuza boss in Osaka, is shocked when she learns that to establish peace between their gangs, she is supposed to become engaged to the grandson of a boss from Tokyo.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Let Me Express My Sincerity, and Maybe Earn Your Affection in the Process
episodes.synopsis:
The daughter of the president of another subsidiary of the Tokusa group has gone missing, so Yoshino must be accompanied around the clock by Kirishima for her safety.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Triangle From Hell
episodes.synopsis:
As she and Kirishima try to figure each other out, some visitors from Kansai cast an ominous light on Yoshino's stay in Tokyo.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Is He Smart or Stupid?
episodes.synopsis:
After a tense encounter between Kirishima and Shouma, Shouma drives back to Osaka. Yoshino gets the sense that something is spoiling Kirishima's mood and confronts him. Like every year, Yoshino catches a summer flu.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Princess Tsubaki
episodes.synopsis:
Yoshino's cousin Tsubaki is moving from Kyoto to Yokohama, which leads to a three-person outing with the two of them and Kirishima.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: I'd Rather You Hate Me than Not Care, Part One
episodes.synopsis:
Yoshino and Kirishima travel to Osaka. She wonders if he is just attached to her or maybe even likes her. But at the same time, Kirishima's former love interest, Nao, is also staying there.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: I'd Rather You Hate Me than Not Care, Part Two
episodes.synopsis:
Yoshino meets Nao at the university, and they exchange contact information. However, Nao is being blackmailed by Ozu to send Kirishima and Yoshino to a place where he can eliminate both of them.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: To Be Honest, I Want to Marry You
episodes.synopsis:
Being blackmailed by Ozu, Nao attempts to trap Kirishima so that the thugs he recently viciously beat up to the point of hospitalization can take revenge on him. Yoshino uncovers the entire scheme and approaches Ozu on her own initiative.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: To Be Honest, I Want to Marry You, Part Two
episodes.synopsis:
While Kirishima is dealing with the men on his tail and meets a certain individual, Yoshino must handle things alone with Naoya.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: To Be Honest, I Want to Marry You, Part Three
episodes.synopsis:
After settling the matter with Ozu and reflecting on a couple of things with Shouma, Yoshino and Kirishima have a chat. What is the status of their bet?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Pet that Becomes Unruly as It Grows
episodes.synopsis:
Despite resolving the matter with Ozu, Yoshino has additional problems to confront: Kirishima and Shouma.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: When She's Upset the Rain Falls and the Dark Night Descends
episodes.synopsis:
"Yoshino and Kirishima have returned to Tokyo and should conclude their discussion that began in Osaka. However, Yoshino behaves as if Kirishima does not exist."

(Source: Crunchyroll)
